referring_durable_medical_equip_<N>: Entity: Referring provider-level aggregated DME/supplier claims and financials; Grain: one row per referring provider (referring_npi) (plus provider name/address columns); Notable keys/measures: referring_npi, referring_provider_last_name_organization_name, referring_provider_first_name, referring_provider_entity_code, number_of_suppliers, number_of_supplier_hcpcs, number_of_supplier_beneficiaries, number_of_supplier_claims, number_of_supplier_services, supplier_submitted_charges, supplier_medicare_allowed_amount, supplier_medicare_payment_amount, durable_medical_equipment_suppression_indicator, number_of_durable_medical_equipment_suppliers, number_of_durable_medical_equipment_hcpcs, number_of_durable_medical_equipment_beneficiaries, number_of_durable_medical_equipment_claims, number_of_durable_medical_equipment_services, durable_medical_equipment_submitted_charges, durable_medical_equipment_medicare_allowed_amount, durable_medical_equipment_medicare_payment_amount, prosthetic_and_orthotic_suppression_indicator, number_of_prosthetic_and_orthotic_suppliers, number_of_prosthetic_and_orthotic_hcpcs, number_of_prosthetic_and_orthotic_beneficiaries, number_of_prosthetic_and_orthotic_claims, number_of_prosthetic_and_orthotic_services, prosthetic_and_orthotic_submitted_charges, prosthetic_and_orthotic_medicare_allowed_amount
hospital_general_info: Entity: Hospital facility metadata and quality measure summary; Grain: one row per hospital (provider_id / hospital_name); Notable keys/measures: provider_id, hospital_name, address, city, state, zip_code, county_name, phone_number, hospital_type, hospital_ownership, emergency_services, meets_criteria_for_promoting_interoperability_of_ehrs, hospital_overall_rating, mortality_group_measure_count, mortality_measures_better_count, mortality_measures_no_different_count, mortality_measures_worse_count, safety_measures_count, safety_measures_better_count, safety_measures_no_different_count, safety_measures_worse_count, readmission_measures_count, readmission_measures_better_count, readmission_measures_no_different_count, readmission_measures_worse_count, patient_experience_measures_count, timely_and_effective_care_measures_count
observation: Entity: Individual clinical observations/measurements recorded for persons; Grain: one row per observation event (observation_id); Notable keys/measures: observation_id, person_id, observation_concept_id, observation_date, observation_datetime, observation_type_concept_id, value_as_number, value_as_string, value_as_concept_id, qualifier_concept_id, unit_concept_id, provider_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_detail_id, observation_source_value, observation_source_concept_id
drug_era: Entity: Continuous eras of drug exposure for a person; Grain: one row per drug era (drug_era_id) for a person+drug_concept_id interval; Notable keys/measures: drug_era_id, person_id, drug_concept_id, drug_era_start_date, drug_era_end_date, drug_exposure_count, gap_days
observation_period: Entity: Time windows during which a person's data are observed/available; Grain: one row per observation period (observation_period_id) per person; Notable keys/measures: observation_period_id, person_id, observation_period_start_date, observation_period_end_date, period_type_concept_id
drug_strength: Entity: Drug strength and packaging / ratio information for drug concepts; Grain: one row per drug_concept_id + ingredient_concept_id (strength record); Notable keys/measures: drug_concept_id, ingredient_concept_id, amount_value, amount_unit_concept_id, numerator_value, numerator_unit_concept_id, denominator_value, denominator_unit_concept_id, box_size, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, invalid_reason
condition_era: Entity: Continuous eras of a condition for a person; Grain: one row per condition era (condition_era_id) for a person+condition_concept_id interval; Notable keys/measures: condition_era_id, person_id, condition_concept_id, condition_era_start_date, condition_era_end_date, condition_occurrence_count
domain: Entity: Vocabulary domain metadata; Grain: one row per domain (domain_id); Notable keys/measures: domain_id, domain_name, domain_concept_id
provider: Entity: Healthcare provider / practitioner records; Grain: one row per provider (provider_id); Notable keys/measures: provider_id, provider_name, npi, dea, specialty_concept_id, care_site_id, year_of_birth, gender_concept_id, provider_source_value, specialty_source_value, gender_source_value
person: Entity: Person (patient) demographic and linkage identifiers; Grain: one row per person (person_id); Notable keys/measures: person_id, gender_concept_id, year_of_birth, month_of_birth, day_of_birth, birth_datetime, race_concept_id, ethnicity_concept_id, location_id, provider_id, care_site_id, person_source_value, gender_source_value, race_source_value, ethnicity_source_value and their source_concept_ids
concept_relationship: Entity: Relationships between vocabulary concepts; Grain: one row per concept-concept relationship (concept_id_1 + concept_id_2 + relationship_id); Notable keys/measures: concept_id_1, concept_id_2, relationship_id, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, invalid_reason
procedure_occurrence: Entity: Performed procedures for persons; Grain: one row per procedure occurrence (procedure_occurrence_id); Notable keys/measures: procedure_occurrence_id, person_id, procedure_concept_id, procedure_type_concept_id, procedure_dat, procedure_datetime, provider_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_detail_id, procedure_source_value, procedure_source_concept_id, modifier_concept_id, modifier_source_value, quantity
care_site: Holds care site entities; grain = one row per care_site (care_site_id); keys/measures = care_site_id, care_site_name, place_of_service_concept_id, location_id, care_site_source_value, place_of_service_source_value.
vocabulary: Holds vocabulary metadata; grain = one row per vocabulary (vocabulary_id); keys/measures = vocabulary_id, vocabulary_name, vocabulary_reference, vocabulary_version, vocabulary_concept_id.
death: Holds death facts for persons; grain = one row per person death event (person_id per death record); keys/measures = person_id, death_date, death_datetime, death_type_concept_id, cause_concept_id, cause_source_value, cause_source_concept_id.
device_exposure: Holds device exposure events; grain = one row per device exposure (device_exposure_id); keys/measures = device_exposure_id, person_id, device_concept_id, device_exposure_start_date, device_exposure_start_datetime, device_exposure_end_date, device_exposure_end_datetime, device_type_concept_id, unique_device_id, quantity, provider_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_detail_id, device_source_value, device_source_concept_id.
relationship: Holds relationship types between concepts/entities; grain = one row per relationship type (relationship_id); keys/measures = relationship_id, relationship_name, is_hierarchical, defines_ancestry, reverse_relationship_id, relationship_concept_id.
payer_plan_period: Holds payer plan enrollment periods; grain = one row per payer plan period (payer_plan_period_id); keys/measures = payer_plan_period_id, person_id, payer_concept_id, payer_source_value, payer_source_concept_id, plan_concept_id, plan_source_value, plan_source_concept_id, sponsor_concept_id, sponsor_source_value, sponsor_source_concept_id, family_source_value, payer_plan_period_start_date, payer_plan_period_end_date, stop_reason_concept_id, stop_reason_source_value, stop_reason_source_concept_id.
concept: Holds concept definitions; grain = one row per concept (concept_id); keys/measures = concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, invalid_reason.
location: Holds physical location addresses; grain = one row per location (location_id); keys/measures = location_id, address_1, address_2, city, state, zip, county, location_source_value.
condition_occurrence: Holds condition occurrence events; grain = one row per condition record (condition_occurrence_id); keys/measures = condition_occurrence_id, person_id, condition_concept_id, condition_start_date, condition_start_datetime, condition_end_date, condition_end_datetime, condition_type_concept_id, stop_reason, provider_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_detail_id, condition_source_value, condition_source_concept_id, condition_status_source_value, condition_status_concept_id.
drug_exposure: Holds drug exposure events; grain = one row per drug exposure (drug_exposure_id); keys/measures = drug_exposure_id, person_id, drug_concept_id, drug_exposure_start_date, drug_exposure_start_datetime, drug_exposure_end_date, drug_exposure_end_datetime, verbatim_end_date, drug_type_concept_id, stop_reason, refills, quantity, days_supply, sig, route_concept_id, lot_number, provider_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_detail_id, drug_source_value, drug_source_concept_id, route_source_value, dose_unit_source_value.
concept_ancestor: Holds ancestor–descendant concept relationships; grain = one row per ancestor–descendant pair; keys/measures = ancestor_concept_id, descendant_concept_id, min_levels_of_separation, max_levels_of_separation.
cost: Holds cost line items for events/domains; grain = one row per cost record (cost_id); keys/measures = cost_id, cost_event_id, cost_domain_id, cost_type_concept_id, currency_concept_id, total_charge, total_cost, total_paid, paid_by_payer, paid_by_patient, paid_patient_copay, paid_patient_coinsurance, paid_patient_deductible, paid_by_primary, paid_ingredient_cost, paid_dispensing_fee, payer_plan_period_id, amount_allowed, revenue_code_concept_id, revenue_code_source_value, drg_concept_id, drg_source_value.
dose_era: Holds drug dose eras for a person; grain = one row per person_id × drug_concept_id × unit_concept_id dose era (dose_era_id); notable keys/measures = dose_era_id (PK), person_id, drug_concept_id, unit_concept_id, dose_value, dose_era_start_date, dose_era_end_date
concept_class: Holds concept class definitions; grain = one row per concept_class_id definition; notable keys/measures = concept_class_id (PK), concept_class_name, concept_class_concept_id
